meaning: Directed inquiry can support examining a favourite version even when clarification feels like saying farewell to an earlier image of shared experience.
text: A favourite version can be difficult to stop repeating when it preserves a cherished image. The Devil in the physical position of Ajna returns discussion to an appealing explanation.
